description: The recorded transition of 2026-11-23 around the C29 and C14 reds, read from the probes' own finished scheduled runs and from the dev branch's first-parent history. No value is imagined.

sources.probe_runs: Finished scheduled runs of each delegation check's workflow in the cloud repository, read through the SCM gateway (onex scm run-list) on 2026-11-24 between 01:25Z and 01:45Z; run id, finish time and success/failure conclusion only. The C14 runs 45185798731 (success) and 45196274344 (failure) were re-read by the building lane; the other checks' runs were read by the same gateway in the same session.
sources.dev_history: git log origin/dev --first-parent --since=2026-11-23T12:00:00Z --until=2026-11-23T14:30:00Z --format=%H|%cI|%s on the omnimarket canonical clone
sources.builds: A build is a dev head commit of that history. The deploy agent's own build record is not readable from a lane, so every first-parent commit from 12:34Z on is taken as a build and a probe run is read as taken on the newest build whose commit time is at or before the run's finish time.
